changelog: v1.4.7 - Deleted-message markers, Supabase-driven channel list, message origin info, ad removal
features: Approve All Requests button in member requests screen and bottom sheet
Restricted toggle in channel 3-dots menu for admins and owners
Restricted toggle calls real Telegram noforwards API (restrict saving content)
Fixed: forwarding multiple messages from an unrestricted channel now sends in one normal batch forward instead of one by one
Fixed: Save to Gallery option for channel profile photo now shows even when the channel is restricted
Forwarding videos from a restricted channel now works the same way audio already did (cache + re-upload)
@mayogram channel shows a custom verified badge and channel icon across the app
Removed the access-code login gate; logged-in accounts are now recorded in Supabase (mayogram_users table)
Official channels to auto-join and pin are now controlled from Supabase instead of hardcoded, and apply to already-logged-in accounts too
Deleted channel posts (with views) are now shown dimmed with a red trash icon instead of disappearing
New 'Show message owner' option shows where a forwarded message originally came from
Bulk-select up to 100 messages at once with the up/down pill while selecting
Removed ads (sponsored channel/bot messages and video pre-roll ads)
Releases are now published automatically from CI
